bible.title: Pledge at Elmwatch
bible.kernel: A border forester hires mercenaries to find the elf promised to him in childhood and bring her to a glade to renew the marriage pledge.

cast.name: Rotlenda
cast.who: human border forester and steward who once swore a childhood pledge to an elf.
cast.want: to bring the pledged elf to Elmwatch Glade and renew the marriage pledge.

cast.name: Quen Elmwhisper
cast.who: elf raised at the forest edge who took to boats to escape human claims.
cast.want: to be free of the pledged marriage and choose a life at sea.

cast.name: Thelfreca
cast.who: elven captain who enforces old clan law and guards forest claims from human interference.
cast.want: to prevent the pledged marriage from being sealed and protect the grove's rights.

bible.situation: Rotlenda still holds to a marriage pledge sworn in childhood as a claim for the border grove. The elf who accepted the pledge left the forests and went to sea rather than submit to human claims. Rotlenda hires the company to find that elf and bring them to Elmwatch Glade so the pledge can be renewed. Elven wardens and coastal hands both care who the elf goes with.
bible.goal: to find the elf pledged in childhood and bring them to Elmwatch Glade to renew the marriage pledge.
arc: Search Weaselrun Hollow, the first place the client named, for signs of the pledged elf → yields: a scrap of weasel pelt tied to a child's ribbon, faint with salt.
Follow the ribbon's salt scent to Fenbar Landing and question river traders using the weasel scrap as evidence → yields: a witness, Han-Ma of the Deep Fens, who says the elf left on a coastal trader.
Use Han-Ma's witness to find the ketch at Rookhaven and ask for the elf aboard → yields: Quen Elmwhisper found living aboard the ketch.

Carry Quen to Elmwatch Glade, the client's delivery ground, and present her to Rotlenda while confronting Thelfreca who blocks the glade. Force Thelfreca to stand down and complete the pledge with Rotlenda
tensions: Thelfreca will claim elven law and refuse any human marriage at the grove.
Coastal crews expect coin or favors and may delay passage to the glade.
Quen's hot temper and wish for freedom may make her refuse to be handed over.
openDirections: Rival harvesters press toward Elmwatch Glade and will seize its trees if the pledge is not sealed quickly.
bible.stakeIfLost: If the pledge is not sealed at Elmwatch Glade the client's right to harvest the northern elms will be lost because rivals will claim the grove first.
bible.arrival: was let in past the hour · asked for the boss by name

shipped.title: Signs at Weaselrun Hollow
shipped.situation: A forester, Rotlenda, was let in past the hour and asked for the boss by name. She keeps her back to the wall and says the pledged elf may be hiding in Weaselrun Hollow. She says that if the pledge is not sealed at Elmwatch Glade the client's right to harvest the northern elms will be lost because rivals will claim the grove first. She wants the pledged elf brought to Elmwatch Glade to renew the marriage pledge, the pay is honest coin, and any small spoils besides. A ship's captain is moving to stop the sealing and to seize the grove's rights.
shipped.job: Find whether the pledged elf is in Weaselrun Hollow.
